title: Avoid Newark Airport this summer
transcript: So Newark is a huge hub for United. A lot of folks have travel out of there this summer. We are telling people at the point Sky if you can change your flight to fly out of LaGuardia, Philadelphia or JFK instead, we recommend doing that. Not so much because of the safety issues though that is a concern, but more because uh so many delays and cancellations are happening. The the big story is a dramatic shortage of air traffic controllers. They don't have the people they need manning uh the Philadelphia Treycon where they run Newark flights from. So, I think it's going to be a mess all summer long. There are efforts underway. There have been efforts underway to solve some of these ATC ATC shortage problems, but we're just not there yet. And I think New York's going to be a mess all summer long.
